purpose.description: Formal theorem-level verification of finite-interface non-identifiability under the declared system class, observation operator, and target functional.
purpose.role: Test whether the interface admits a valid factorization of the target.

observation_operator.description: Frozen finite behavioral interface mapping systems to observable traces.

target_functional.description: Declared adaptive target evaluated on system trajectories.

identifiability_question.statement: Does there exist L_hat such that L = L_hat o O on F?

equivalent_form.general_case: target is constant on observation equivalence classes

theorem_result.statement: No function L_hat defined on O(F) can recover L over the declared finite class.

gate_003.role: formal theorem packaging of finite-interface obstruction

decision.meaning: The frozen finite interface cannot identify the declared target.
decision.next_authorized_action: change the interface, target, or declared system class and register a new gate

notes: The result is a factorization failure, not an estimator failure.
